entities.summary: The Bloody Beetroots (b. 1977-12-18, Bassano del Grappa) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bassano del Grappa and Italy. Known in the fields of italy, painters & sculptors, europe.
